name: Spliit
title: Spliit: free Splitwise alternative
caption:
Splitwise Pro charges $39.99/year to lift its daily expense limit. Spliit splits the bills for free 💸

✅ Groups for trips, events and gifts, shared with a link
✅ Split evenly, by shares, by percentage or by exact amount
✅ Balances show who owes whom, plus the payments that settle up
✅ Scan or attach receipts, no ads, no account

💻 Any browser · iPhone
ℹ️ The hosted spliit.app is paid for by donations, and there's no Android app (the website works in any browser)

Comment "BILLS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #splitwise #travel #budgeting #freeapps #techtips
